checks.name: Wiring orphan symbols
checks.rationale: More than 100 orphans indicates significant wiring debt. ADVISORY (investigation 2026-07-01): the meter is not yet trustworthy — the count is cwd-sensitive (rust=5016 vs home=27088) and a Chain-7 spot-check found 3/4 sampled orphans have real consumers via grep (incomplete consumer population in wiring_map). Re-arm as blocking only after the wiring_map is repopulated and the FP rate is measured low.

checks.name: RL EMA reward (OnlineRL engine)
checks.rationale: EMA reward < 0.2 means the RL loop hasn't converged yet. ADVISORY (investigation 2026-07-01): the value lives in the in-memory OnlineRLEngine, which resets on every daemon restart and re-injects a synthetic 0.2 warmup — so the first post-restart samples sit deterministically just under the 0.2 threshold (0.179606 observed byte-identical across days). A non-advisory gate on this source fails structurally after every restart without signalling anything. Re-arm only if the EMA gains durable persistence.

checks.name: Query cache hit ratio (W17/W18)
checks.rationale: Hit ratio >= 0.5 confirms cache is paying for itself. ADVISORY (2026-07-01): same structural pattern as ema_reward — the moka cache is in-memory and resets to 0.0 on every daemon restart (measured 0.0 → 0.71 post-warm, telemetry §1.4), so a non-advisory gate fails transiently after each restart without signalling anything. Re-arm if the ratio gains uptime-aware gating or persistence.

checks.name: Blast radius P99 timeout (D5)
checks.rationale: Any blast timeout indicates predictive layer regression.

checks.name: MCTS shadow deadlock detection (D5)
checks.rationale: Deadlock detection guards async actor invariants.

checks.name: Gotcha resolution count
checks.rationale: Gotchas should be progressively resolved over time.

checks.name: Total nextest count
checks.rationale: Test count is a leading indicator of confidence; do not regress.

checks.name: Line coverage (cargo llvm-cov)
checks.rationale: 75% line coverage is the minimum bar set by docs/ci-template.yml.

checks.name: Mutation test kill_rate (touring-ast, advisory)
checks.rationale: Mutation testing measures how many fault injections the test suite catches. Week 1-2 baseline is 50% (advisory); ramps to 80% by month 3. See docs/mutation-testing.md.

checks.name: Coupling STR — enrichment bytes per emit (D2, leading)
checks.rationale: Signal-to-token: bytes injected per enrichment emit. Measured baseline 1029; target lte 800 forces tighter context without losing the actionable signal.

checks.name: Coupling hook dispatch latency p50 (D5, leading)
checks.rationale: Common-case hook cost must stay ~1ms so enrichment is free at the point of action. Watches the median, not the cold-start tail (see p99).

checks.name: Coupling hook dispatch latency p99 (D5, leading)
checks.rationale: Tail-latency guard (cold-start/cargo). Calibrated to 50ms — not 1ms — to watch the real tail without false alarms (telemetry §1.4).

checks.name: Coupling actor queue-wait p99 — serialized-actor backpressure (D5, leading, F8)
checks.rationale: Time a RunHook waited in the per-project actor's serial mpsc before dequeue (F8, 2026-07-01). hook_dispatch_latency starts at dequeue, so this wait was invisible — it is the cross-session contention signal (one session's heavy hook stalling another's in the same project). >1s p99 = contention; advisory until a 2-week baseline exists.

checks.name: Coupling health-delta net — improvements minus regressions (D4, lagging)
checks.rationale: Net effectiveness: coupling-guided edits should improve more paths than they regress. Derived from gate-metrics health_delta_{improvement,regression}_count.

checks.name: Coupling world-model success rate — P(success|action) (D6, lagging)
checks.rationale: Mean P(success) across the durable action_world_model.json (21k+ examples). The cross-session learning signal; gte 0.70 indicates the harness is converging.

checks.name: Coupling suggestion-uptake — redirect followed / emitted (D3, leading)
checks.rationale: The decisive coupling KPI (telemetry §9, F2): after cli_suggester emits a touring/code-mode redirect, did the LLM's next same-session action follow it? followed/emitted over the daemon lifetime. gte 0.40 = the hint changes behaviour rather than being ignored (banner-blindness). Conservative 1-step window; STUB until the first suggestion is emitted.

checks.name: Coupling adoption_ratio — touring vs raw-bash among Bash actions (D3, the mother metric)
checks.rationale: The mother coupling KPI (telemetry §9, F3): the prior-bash->prior-touring inversion. Among Bash invocations, the fraction that call `touring` vs raw-shell antipatterns (grep/cat/find/sed) — touring/(touring+antipattern) over the daemon lifetime. Unconditional (every Bash action), unlike F2's suggestion-gated uptake. gte 0.50 = touring is the default reach, not the exception (the prior has flipped). STUB until the first Bash action is classified.

checks.name: Coupling pillar-induction — pillar nudge followed / emitted (Task #6, armed-only)
checks.rationale: Task #6 compounding structure (the active hook layer): after the armed pillar-induction layer nudges a differential the upstream classifiers miss (master-cli or learning-memory), did the LLM's next same-session action take it (a master/recall command)? followed/emitted over the daemon lifetime, precise predicate. gte 0.50 = the master commands are reached for once nudged. DEFAULT-OFF (TOURING_PILLAR_INDUCTION_ARMED) — STUB until armed; if it stays low while armed, that is the affordance-over-persuasion evidence (telemetry thesis ①) pushing toward productization.
